architecture: base omniASR CTC orthography (frozen) + linear head over character n-grams
input: orthographic text from a base omniASR CTC model; the head is trained on 40-character windows and classifies whole transcripts

features.tokenisation: char_wb: each word padded with one space either side, n-grams taken within the padded word over CODEPOINTS not bytes
features.casefold: casefold.txt maps every uppercase form occurring in the vocabulary; Unicode folding (Ɛ->ɛ) that std::tolower cannot do

onnx.notes: core operators only; no com.microsoft contrib ops, so mobile onnxruntime works

notes: give it five seconds of speech minimum and ten for the best result: measured out of domain, 3 s scores 0.506, 5 s 0.657, 7 s 0.759 and whole clips averaging 9.7 s 0.777. check most of the audio is speech first
